opus.problem: Naming 'its queen' with Solomon gives the word away on its own. Only one foreign queen visits Solomon, so any baker who knows the story answers Sheba at once. This clue is not medium hard.
'Its queen' telling Solomon that not even half was reported is the best-known line of the queen of Sheba story. Together with the queen and Solomon setting, this clue alone gives the word away.

'Its queen' giving King Solomon spices names the queen of Sheba's visit directly, so this clue alone gives the word away. With clues 1 and 2, three of the seven clues each reveal the answer by themselves.
